title: Analytical Platform and Code for the Structured Dataset on Global Research of Violence Against Women
description: Analytical platform and code of a scoping review of the global empirical literature on violence against women: supervised screening and topic modelling pipelines, reproducible statistics, data dictionary and the interactive platform at https://vcm.cienciaberta.com.
